# Stock vbsp's slanted load-time planes on sdk_ctf_2fort, with the three
# points each was made from. Read by PlaneFromPointsNormaliseTests.
#
# Source: Source SDK Base 2013 Multiplayer's x64 vbsp.exe (Feb 17 2025),
# default options, on maps/sdk_ctf_2fort.vmf (sha256 d4139b7b...ff3ab3),
# compiled on an AMD machine. The normal and distance are the exact bits of
# that BSP's PLANES lump; the points are the VMF side that created the plane.
#
# How the rows were chosen: the plane table is append-only and built in side
# order, so stock's plane N was created by the side that creates this
# port's plane N, for as long as the two tables stay in step. Each row is a
# side whose plane is not snapped to an axis, and whose stock plane at that
# index is within 1e-5 per normal component and 0.01 in distance of the
# plane this port derives from the same points. Planes the tables disagree
# on past that point (a bevel's distance moved by winding noise shifts the
# numbering) are left out, so no row compares two different planes.
#
# Columns: stock plane index; p0 p1 p2 as nine floats; stock normal x y z
# and distance as the hex bits of IEEE singles.
